adjudication_result.rationale: I reviewed the candidate patch and validation results. The candidate rejects empty and non-string file names, resolves the allowed root and requested path, and checks the resolved path against the root plus the platform path separator. This prevents parent traversal and sibling-prefix paths from being accepted. The recorded valid-file control and parent-traversal attack passed, all three functional tests passed, syntax passed, and no new SAST findings appeared. The CWE-22 warning remains at the path resolution operation, but it does not appear to account for the containment check that follows. I accept this candidate for the controlled /file route. Encoded inputs, repeated parameters, platform-specific variations, and symlink behavior remain limitations for supplemental testing.
